reference.about: The master data sheet (track MP, design handover/design/SSE4-matter-pack-design.md): constants of nature, conventions, reference objects, elements, isotopes, substances and mixtures, each value with its source. Built by scripts/build-base-reference.py; MP2 first wave. A value without "check" is verified against its source; "unverified" means the source is named but the number was not read from it; "authored" is a documented stand-in (docs/fudges.md).

origin_story.physics: Gold is almost entirely an r-process element: about 94% of the Sun's gold came from rapid neutron capture, here given to neutron-star mergers, and about 6% from the s-process in giant stars. A merger making heavy elements has been seen once directly (GW170817 and its kilonova). Whether mergers make nearly all the gold, or rare supernovae such as collapsars add a share, is still argued.

origin_story.story: Every ring was forged in a collision of two dead stars, so dense a teaspoon weighed a billion tonnes. The gold was flung out, drifted for hundreds of millions of years, and was swept into the cloud that made this star.
